verdict.rationale: Column documents that it supports card programs: as an issuing bank on Visa and Mastercard, it lets partners offer physical and virtual cards. However, the docs say this works through 'all major networks and issuer processors', which implies a third-party issuer processor rather than card issuance from the same accounts API. Missing for 10: documented card-issuance API endpoints tied to bank accounts, spend controls, digital wallet (Apple/Google Pay) support, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, accounts come with cards — issue virtual and physical debit cards tied to the account through the same API, with spend controls and digital wallet support

citations.quote: Build a card program with Column to offer your customers any type of card. We work with all major networks and issuer processors.
We're an issuing bank and sponsor card programs on Visa & Mastercard. Our partners can offer both physical and virtual cards to users.
